title: The Background Check Fee
intro: You got a job offer after a short chat. Now they say you must pay for your own background check.
Tap anything that looks odd to sniff it closer. Pin what is suspicious, clear what is harmless.
When you are sure, decide what to do.

notify.text: Welcome! One last step: background check fee

subject.text: Welcome! One last step before you start

p: You are hired! Before you start,

p.text: Pay within 24 hours or your offer is cancelled.
The fee will be refunded in your first pay.

addr.label: A look-alike address
addr.lens: It comes from quillon-hiring-desk.live, not the company's own domain.
addr.why: Look at the address behind the name.

fee.label: You pay for the check
fee.lens: An honest employer pays for its own checks.
fee.why: Honest employers never ask candidates to pay.

link.label: A payment link
link.lens: The button goes to a payment page.
link.why: Never pay through an email link.

refund.label: "Refunded in your first pay"
refund.lens: A promise to win your trust.

check.label: A background check
check.why: Checks are normal. Paying for them yourself is not.

actions.label: Call the company's real HR on a number I look up myself

trap.title: Quillon Hiring · Check fee
trap.ask: Pay £75 by card for your background check.

block_report.line: Reported and deleted. The fake address was blocked.

verify.line: The company's real HR had no record of you and said: "We never charge candidates for checks." Case cracked.

ignore.line: You stayed safe. But the same scam is still landing on other people.

go_ahead.line: The £75 went to a stranger. There was never a job, and the "company" vanished.

what_if.go_ahead: Honest employers pay for their own checks. A call to the real HR would have ended it.
what_if.ignore: Reporting takes two taps and helps protect other people.
what_if.verify: Checking was smart. Reporting it as well helps protect other people.

golden_rule: An employer pays for its own checks. A fee from you, to get a job, is a scam.

quick_check.q: After a job offer, an email says you must pay £75 for a background check through a link. What do you do?

options.text: Pay, it is small and refundable
Do not pay. Call the company's real HR on a number you look up, and report

quick_check.explain: An honest employer never asks you to pay.

hints.nudge: Who normally pays for a background check?
